rule: Select one primary packet. Actual proof dependencies and status require original evidence; upstream lists are advisory. Review nominees recuse if contributors.

assignments.target_statement: Choose an explicit spectral reference Q and retain all normalizers and support terms. For the collision candidate preserve T=L/Z=H(v/Z)−log₂Z, which is tensor-additive; fixed raw-L payment is already refuted by genuine Boolean tensor powers. Seek a quantitative normalized divergence payment for a named excess term, separately proving the recovery implication needed downstream.

deliverables.description: REFERENCE_DIVERGENCE.tex: Q, support, normalizer, and target excess term

acceptance_criteria: Define C_b(U), v_U=C_b(U)², Z=Σv_U, L=Σv_U log₂(1/v_U), and T=L/Z=H(v/Z)−log₂Z; use product-compatible completions when invoking tensor additivity.
Import the Boolean tensor-power failure of fixed raw-L payment and keep lower-payment and sufficient-recovery inequalities as separate targets.
Any bound K_full≥T/4−κI on the admitted full-support low-I class remains an unproved FEI-strength target; prove a genuinely quantitative step or state a restricted scope.

next_consumers.interface_use: actual information projection and support normalization

assignments.renewal_milestone: A new normalized divergence payment or a rigorously scoped obstruction with the raw-L baseline already excluded.

assignments.target_statement: Develop chain rules for posterior witness information across an adaptive hierarchy. Prove the total released credit is bounded by an initial resource and cannot be spent again after conditioning.

deliverables.description: POSTERIOR_CREDIT_CHAIN.tex: conditional information chain rule and release process
NO_REUSE_CERTIFICATE.md: initial resource, increments, and terminal remainder

acceptance_criteria: Own the posterior chain-rule/no-reuse identity; A023 owns rare first-revelation families and A029 owns physical-child deficit transport.
Specify the common joint probability space before comparing posterior entropies across nodes; credits from incompatible reference laws cannot be added without a proved correction.
Prove the finite-tree cumulative bound and retain a terminal credit/remainder instead of assuming it vanishes.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A reusable exact credit-release interface with a proved finite-tree inequality or a concrete failure of the proposed resource.

assignments.target_statement: Retrieve the exact current Brain definition of the occupancy-information or K_occ candidate before working on it. Prove a quantitative lower bound with an explicit target debt, or archive a source-exact counterexample.

deliverables.description: OCCUPANCY_TARGET_SOURCE.md: exact current definition, formula, units, and correction chain
OCCUPANCY_PAYMENT.tex: quantified debt payment or source-exact counterexample

acceptance_criteria: Retrieve the original definition of K_occ before using the symbol; the route-map is a retrieval index and cannot replace the complete candidate formula.
Import the failed fixed positive occurrence-reserve rule and state whether a proposed nonlinear/state-dependent payment avoids its exact witness.
Specify the debt being paid, its bias/sign/reference changes, and whether the balanced-slice target is already FEI-strength; positivity of K_occ alone is no result.
assignments.renewal_milestone: An admitted exact target and one new quantitative derivation or certified counterexample; unavailable definitions keep only the source-resolution part open.

assignments.target_statement: Study how an information projection changes under a physical restriction. Establish a monotonicity or compensated identity that remains valid when the two child spectra interfere coherently.

deliverables.description: PROJECTION_RESTRICTION.tex: compensated restriction identity or monotonicity theorem
COHERENT_CHILD_EXAMPLES.json: exact child spectra and reference changes

acceptance_criteria: Construct the proposed stochastic map explicitly before invoking data processing; physical restriction produces coherent child spectra and need not be a channel on squared parent coefficients.
Track reoptimization of the reference, its normalizer, and support changes in both children.
Verify equality on an isospectral split and locate the compensating term for a non-isospectral Boolean control.

advisory_upstream.interface: actual information projection and support normalization

assignments.renewal_milestone: A proved restriction identity with a usable compensation term or a minimal coherent-child counterexample.

assignments.target_statement: Construct examples where every proposed KL term is positive but much smaller than the unpaid entropy. Require asymptotic ratios, not a statement that relative entropy is nonnegative.

deliverables.description: CREDIT_TO_DEBT_RATIOS.tex: exact candidate credits and unpaid entropy
NORMALIZATION_COUNTERCONTROLS.md: old raw-L failure versus new T/shape tests

acceptance_criteria: Compute asymptotic credit/debt ratios after retaining Z and every support-conditioning term.
Include the already known raw-L Boolean tensor-power failure and shape under-recovery example as controls, not new results.
A new counterfamily must refute the stated direction and coefficient; failure of upper recovery cannot be substituted for failure of lower payment.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A rigorous family separating a live normalized credit from its target debt, or a narrowed surviving coefficient range.
